svg.text: SIX WAYS TO GET THIS WRONG

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rk is the row number on the Baseball-Reference page, not an identifier. Standard_Batting and Value_Batting share all 23,320 (Season, Team,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rk) keys, yet the same Rk points at the same player only 3.9% of the time. The join looks perfect - right row count, no error - and attaches

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the wrong player to 96% of rows. Use Player_ID.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Filter Row_Type = "data" before you total anything.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 46 of the 108 tables end with footer rows such as Team Totals, Non-Pitcher Totals and Rank in 2 AL. They sit in the same table as the

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: players, so any untotalled sum counts each club twice.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drop the league row from Team_* tables.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Most team-level tables carry a league-average row per season, so they are 620 rows rather than 600. Keep only rows whose Team is a real club

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Never union regular-season tables with advanced ones.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: regular_season is scraped per club, so a traded player appears once per club. The advanced folder comes from league pages and adds a

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: combined 2TM/3TM row on top. Union them and those players are counted twice.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: OAK through 2024 and ATH from 2025 are one club. FLA to MIA in 2012, TBD to TBR in 2008, and Houston moved from the NL to the AL in 2013.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Compare rates rather than totals across those years. Postseason and award-voting tables stop at 2025.
